title: Collinear carbons in X: double acetylide alkylation of buta-1,3-diyne with trans-crotyl bromide
summary: Buta-1,3-diyne, two equivalents of NaNH2 and excess trans-crotyl bromide, watched at two levels at once: the liquid-ammonia flask on the left, the molecules on the right, in step. Curved arrows move each electron pair as NH2- pulls off both acidic sp C-H protons and each acetylide carbanion attacks a CH2-Br from the back (SN2, Walden umbrella flip), while the grey NaNH2 is used up and white NaBr settles. X is then relaxed to its real angles (sp 180, sp2 120, sp3 109.5 degrees) and spun about its axis: the carbons that never move are counted. Products come from pushing the arrows on molecule graphs; the count is made twice, by rule and on a geometric model. No prediction stage - input, run, watch, result.
subject: Chemistry
topic: Alkynes - acidity of terminal alkynes, acetylide SN2 alkylation and linear sp geometry
subtopics: Acidity of terminal alkynes (sp C-H, pKa about 25)
Acetylide ions as nucleophiles: SN2 on primary halides
Hybridisation and bond angles: sp, sp2, sp3
Counting collinear atoms in a molecule
concepts: Two equivalents of NaNH2 remove both terminal sp C-H protons of buta-1,3-diyne, giving the acetylide dianion
Each acetylide attacks the CH2 of trans-crotyl bromide by SN2 (backside attack, one step); the trans C=C is untouched
X = CH3CH=CHCH2-C#C-C#C-CH2CH=CHCH3 (C12H14), with 4 sp carbons in the middle
An sp carbon holds its two neighbours at 180 degrees, so the four sp carbons and the two CH2 carbons bonded to them lie on one line
The CH2 is sp3 (109.5 degrees) and the next carbon is sp2, so the line stops there: 6
formulas: C4H2 + 2 C4H7Br -> C12H14 + 2 HBr (as NaBr + NH3)

methods: Solved independently before any key was consulted: X = CH3CH=CHCH2-C#C-C#C-CH2CH=CHCH3, 6 collinear carbons
RDKit reaction templates: deprotonation once per equivalent of NaNH2 and acetylide SN2 on the primary bromide generate X (C12H14, E,E kept); the templates do not fire where they must not
RDKit hybridisation: 4 sp, 4 sp2, 4 sp3 carbons
MMFF 3-D models (20 conformers): the largest set of carbons within 0.10 A of one line is 6 in every conformer; the next carbon is 1.4 A off the line
Custom controls: hexatriyne 8, ethyne 4, one equivalent 5, allyl or propargyl bromide 6 - rule, 3-D model and page agree
Independent script tests/verify_p1q12.py: 26 of 26 checks pass
Solution websites: MathonGo's published solution (their Q44) gives 6
